content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I have reviewed the draft and would like to suggest a clarification before signing:
- The relevant clause states that the Adviser may take "any other action with respect to the Fund as may be necessary in the opinion of the Adviser to perform its duties hereunder." This could require additional work without a clear limit or change‑order process, which may expand the workload unpredictably. I propose that the agreement specify that the Adviser shall perform only the services listed in Schedule A and shall not be required to perform any additional actions unless a written change order, signed by both parties, outlines the new work and any associated compensation.

Thank you for considering these adjustments.

Best regards,
